release-item.p: An error queued by the OpenSSL config or left over from an earlier failure could be reported instead of the actual failure, e.g. ssl command section not found for an invalid tls-cipher-12 value. System errors such as a missing CA file reported no details available with OpenSSL >= 3.0 and now report the system error message.

commit.subject: Document TLS settings skipped when repo-storage-verify-tls=n.

release-item.p: Document TLS settings skipped when repo-storage-verify-tls=n.
With repo-storage-verify-tls=n the TLSv1.2 minimum is not set and the tls-cipher-12 and tls-cipher-13 options are ignored for repository storage connections.
